title: COMPLETE Astro Framework Migration Phase 5 Testing and CI/CD Pipeline
content:
**What**: Integrated Astro `pnpm build` step into `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and verified 100% passing tests (9/9) with 43.3% code coverage.
**Why**: Ensures automated quality gates validate both Astro frontend production bundling and backend PostgreSQL integration on every push to `dev` or `main`.
**Where**: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `tests/`, `package.json`.
**Learned**: Pre-building Astro in CI/CD before running PostgreSQL integration tests guarantees complete build integrity across the entire application stack.
